title: Specification delta
description: The transient artifact describing one requested change by reference. it to references rather than content: restating an artifact here would put a second copy of it in a temporary file, and the copy is the one that stops being maintained. Produced by spec-delta-author. It has no mechanical consumer since the workflow machinery was removed: the delta is read by whoever performs the change. Its persistence is run-scoped — nothing outside the run reads it, and what survives is the event that records the phase.

state.description: The closed set a consumer branches on. Two rather than three: a delta is a description of what will change, so it has no `updated` counterpart the way an authoring result does — it is either written or it is blocked on something absent.

changes.description: Every artifact the change touches, by reference and with the operation. Empty only on a blocked delta.

reason.description: Why this artifact changes. A reference with no reason names a file and states nothing about the change.
